caption: First bundle saved on the Free plan: Bundle #1, 10% Off, Active, type Fixed bundle, under an Upgrade banner; the store name is hidden.
The bundle only showed in the theme preview after the app embed was switched on: Bundle Product #1 at $1,382.31 instead of $1,535.90, with a Sale label and Add to cart.
Fixed bundle, Volume discounts and Buy X Get Y | Free gift sit in the same app, and Fixed bundle is marked Best match for the test store; the store name is hidden.
The Free plan caps bundle sales at $500 per cycle (here $0 of $500, 16 Nov to 16 Dec 2026), and a Black Friday banner offers $160 off Enterprise for 1 month; the store name is hidden.

Plan comparison: auto bundle detection in cart, Shopify POS integration and post-purchase order split are ticked only in the last column, Enterprise. Cancelling runs through a link in the Subscription cancellation box; the store name is hidden.
App Store pricing: free only on development stores, then Standard at $19, $49 or $139 a month for up to $1,000, $3,000 or $10,000 of monthly bundle sales.
Shopify approval for Standard (1K): $19,00 USD every 30 days after a 7-day trial ending 23 Nov, before taxes. Approve stayed greyed out and nothing was paid; the store name is hidden.
